column3: Can I upgrade the RAM or storage later?
column4: Upgrade options depend on the laptop model. Some models support RAM or SSD upgrades, while others have soldered components.

column3: Do all laptops come with Windows pre-installed?
column4: No. Operating systems vary by model. Check the product listing for Windows, Linux or operating system details.

column3: How can I choose a laptop for gaming or programming?
column4: For gaming, consider a dedicated GPU, a capable processor and at least 16 GB RAM. For programming, consider a modern processor, 16 GB RAM or more and an SSD.

column3: Are laptop specifications and prices accurate?
column4: Product prices and specifications are maintained in the VoltKart product catalogue. The catalogue is the reference for recommendations and comparisons.

column3: Can I cancel an order after placing it?
column4: Orders can be cancelled before they are shipped. Once shipped, cancellation may not be available. Contact customer support for assistance.

column3: Can I change my delivery address after ordering?
column4: Address changes are allowed only before the order is dispatched. Contact customer support as soon as possible.

column3: What if I receive a damaged laptop?
column4: Please report the issue within 48 hours of delivery and provide supporting photographs or videos. The support team will review the request.

column3: Do laptops come with a warranty?
column4: Warranty coverage depends on the manufacturer and laptop model. Refer to the product listing or manufacturer warranty information for exact coverage.
